q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a clinic or small hospital?
title: Clinic carbon footprint calculation
short: Start with the clinic electricity bill at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, add generator diesel at 2.68 kg per litre, AC refrigerant top-ups and any anaesthetic gases, then divide by patient visits. Medicines and supplies go in Scope 3 once the basics are in place.
audience: Clinics, diagnostic centres and nursing homes

ul: Generator diesel and refrigerant top-ups: Scope 1.
Anaesthetic gases released, if surgery is done: Scope 1.
Medicines and consumables, from purchase invoices.
Biomedical waste treatment, from the treatment facility.
Staff commuting, if you want the fuller picture.

p: Divide by patient visits in the month from your billing system, and keep a separate figure for any inpatient beds.

example.title: Worked example: one clinic (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Clinic total: 1,385.2 kg CO2 a month
Per patient visit at 1,200 visits: 1.154 kg CO2
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and visit count.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
